title: How the RP session can end
desc: Three stages. First the sign-in: the assertion is valid and the relying party creates its own session, which is its to design. Then the IdP session ends or the account is disabled: the RP session is independent of IdP state and SessionNotOnOrAfter does not move. Finally the RP session can end by three routes: the IdP signals (SHOULD), the RP ends it (MAY), or SessionNotOnOrAfter passes, if it was sent (SHOULD).
